in_marathi.name: Chintan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chintan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chintan is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'chin' meaning 'to think'. This name signifies one who is engaged in deep thought, reflection or meditation.
